classification: Exploratory clean pilot; one pair per case, not a repeated performance estimate
post_run_change: Clipboard restore script now concatenates serialized parameters instead of sequential placeholder replacement; tested ROOT/SAVED literals. No product, skill, task or participant evidence changes.

protocol.timer: Full model turn including skill/API discovery; coordinator setup/verification/cleanup excluded
protocol.isolation: Fresh profile, thread, neutral cwd, fixtures and cu runtime; cleared clipboard; project docs and memories disabled; actual context and all tool arguments audited
protocol.application_sessions: Dedicated task windows in shared Finder and TextEdit processes; app preferences and desktop are not reset between arms
protocol.order: cu then native for both cases; one pair each, no counterbalanced conclusion
protocol.clipboard_backups: Private and excluded from this artifact
protocol.tool_calls: Outer shell or CUA tool calls, including discovery; not individual backend actions
protocol.tool_errors: Outer calls reporting an error; does not count all silent effect failures
protocol.non_tool_interval: Residual elapsed time, includes model/network/orchestration; not pure inference
protocol.post_save_tool_calls: Calls ending after first exact passive file observation, including overlap; not necessarily redundant

audit.note: Reviewed full command trace: assigned cu UI route only, skill/reference reads and task launcher permitted, no direct document IO or scripting. Pasteboard cleared before the turn. Actual cmd+c from current Incoming preceded successful paste; requested rename was performed and corrected visibly. Exact file-set/content verifier passed. Shared Finder process; task-owned copies and recoverable deletions occurred during recovery.
strategy_notes: Three attempts to open a list item before keyboard navigation.
Unsupported Finder Cut, duplicate paste/move attempts, and extension corrections added recovery.
Some deterministic actions were grouped, but grouping crossed navigation boundaries.

audit.note: Reviewed all tool arguments and final result: native Finder App APIs only, no shell/document IO or scripting. Pasteboard cleared before the turn. Coordinates followed Finder screenshots. Selected current Incoming files with Copy and Move Item Here, then renamed archive; independent exact file set and content oracle passed. Dedicated test window closed; shared Finder process retained.
strategy_notes: Unsupported Finder Cut and ineffective rename attempts required recovery.
A stale element ID after navigation and one unavailable screenshot returned tool errors.
Menu remained open across Escape/navigation attempts; repeated full-tree observations and menu recovery added rounds.

audit.note: Reviewed all commands: packaged skill/reference reads, task launcher initialization and cu UI actions only. No direct document IO, application scripting, oracle feedback or whole-document replacement. Local section insertion used text already observed in the assigned UI. Exact saved bytes passed after selection/heading/blank-line recovery. Shared TextEdit process retained and task window closed.
strategy_notes: Grouped field changes preserved the similar archived section.
Unsupported ArrowDown alias and an unchanged search-field write produced two errors.
Home did not clear the search selection: section insertion replaced Archived window. Model repaired the heading and extra newlines from returned UI state.

audit.note: Reviewed complete tool trace: native TextEdit App APIs only, no direct document IO, application scripting, oracle feedback or whole-document replacement. Text selections used observed document contents. Exact saved bytes passed after checklist/spacing recovery. Task window closed and shared TextEdit process retained.
strategy_notes: Used contextual selectText instead of Find/keyboard navigation.
A grouped selection failed after an earlier edit; one full state refresh preceded retry.
Checklist typing changed characters and joined lines despite successful dispatch; observed state triggered undo and smaller edits.
Moved Contacts via cut/paste and repaired section/trailing spacing before saving.
